facts.text: Raffles Doha is located within Katara Towers, which were inspired by the crossed swords of Qatar.
facts.excerpt: Raffles is located within the striking Katara Towers, inspired by the crossed swords of Qatar.

facts.text: Raffles Doha is in Lusail City, Qatar.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Doha is located in Lusail City, Qatar, inside the landmark Katara Towers.

facts.text: The hotel is approximately 25 minutes from Hamad International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is approximately 25 minutes from Hamad International Airport

facts.text: Every accommodation at Raffles Doha is a suite.
facts.excerpt: Every accommodation is a luxury suite.

facts.text: Every suite reservation includes dedicated Raffles Butler Service, which assists with unpacking, garment pressing, dining reservations and transportation arrangements.
facts.excerpt: Every suite reservation at Raffles Doha includes dedicated Raffles Butler Service. The butler assists with unpacking, garment pressing, dining reservations, transportation arrangements

facts.text: Alba is the hotel's Michelin-starred Italian restaurant.
facts.excerpt: from **Alba**, the hotel's Michelin-starred Italian restaurant

facts.text: ALBA serves Italian cuisine inspired by the truffle of northern Italy.
facts.excerpt: ALBA celebrates the artistry of Italian cuisine with contemporary flair, inspired by the rare truffle of northern Italy.

facts.text: Aqua serves Mediterranean cuisine by the pool.
facts.excerpt: **Aqua**, serving Mediterranean cuisine by the pool

facts.text: Acoustic is a rooftop venue with panoramic Lusail skyline views.
facts.excerpt: **Acoustic**, a rooftop venue with panoramic Lusail skyline views

facts.text: The hotel runs a guided hotel tour; the 10:00 am tour includes a light morning tea in Acoustic and the 3:00 pm tour a light afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: Guests of the 10:00 am tour will enjoy a light morning tea in Acoustic, while the 3:00 pm tour includes a light afternoon tea.

facts.text: Advance reservations are required for the guided hotel tour.
facts.excerpt: Advance reservations are required.

facts.text: Raffles Spa & Wellness has private Spa Suites.
facts.excerpt: From our private Spa Suites to tailored fitness journeys

facts.text: Katara Hall is the hotel's ballroom, with arched ceilings, Arabesque artistry and panoramic terraces.
facts.excerpt: Katara Hall is a spectacular space at the heart of the hotel, resplendent with soaring, arched ceilings, Arabesque artistry and panoramic terraces.

facts.text: Katara Hall is described as the largest ballroom in the city.
facts.excerpt: This awe-inspiring ballroom, the largest in the city, can accommodate up to 2,500 guests

facts.text: Katara Hall's terraces overlook Lusail Marina.
facts.excerpt: Katara Hall's sweeping terraces that overlook fashionable Lusail Marina and the azure seas beyond are also yours to enjoy

facts.text: Katara Towers is the first hospitality project in Qatar to receive GSAS Design & Build 5 Stars certification at the design stage.
facts.excerpt: Katara Towers, home to Raffles Doha, is the first hospitality project in Qatar to receive certificate for GSAS Design & Build 5 Stars rating at the design stage.

facts.text: The hotel has a Little Guests programme of activities for children.
facts.excerpt: A world full of surprises and activities to intrigue and engage our little guests.

facts.text: The Royal Suites are a collection of four themed suites.
facts.excerpt: Experience the pinnacle of luxury through our collection of four distinctive themed suites

facts.text: Suites have a room management and multisensory system controlled via an in-suite tablet.
facts.excerpt: Room management & multisensory system via in-suite tablet

facts.text: The Urban Signature Suite has an experience shower and a private steam room.
facts.excerpt: Experience shower & private steam room

facts.text: The Gulf Signature Suite has a salon with a library and art wall.
facts.excerpt: A spacious salon features a library and art wall

facts.text: The hotel suggests November to April as the ideal time to visit Doha, when the weather is pleasant.
facts.excerpt: The ideal time to visit is between November and April, when the weather is pleasant

facts.text: The hotel is close to Place Vendome Mall, Lusail Marina, Lusail Boulevard and Katara Cultural Village.
